mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.password_setup_email_verification (user_id, secret_hash, expires_at, created_at) SELECT #{userId}, #{secretHash}, #{expiresAt}, statement_timestamp() WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.password_setup_email_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at > transaction_timestamp() - INTERVAL '1 minute' )
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, secret_hash, failed_attempts, expires_at, used_at FROM public.password_setup_email_verification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
